instructions: Rinse the 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice in a sieve until the water runs mostly clear. Put it in a saucepan with 2 1/4 cups water and bring it to a boil over high heat. Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 15 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave it covered for 5 minutes. No peeking.
Meanwhile, bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Cut the celery stalks on a slant into slices about 1/4 inch thick.
Cut the smoked tofu into strips about 1/4 inch thick and 2 inches long. Slice the green onions, mince the 2 tbsp ginger and mince the 3 garlic cloves.
In a small bowl, stir together 2 tbsp of the soy sauce, 3 tbsp water, the 1/2 tsp sugar and the 1 tsp cornstarch until the cornstarch dissolves.
Put the celery in the boiling water for 30 seconds, then drain it and rinse it under cold water. Shake it dry.
Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat until it's hot. Add 2 tbsp of the oil and spread the tofu in one layer. Leave it for 2 minutes, until the underside is browned.
Toss the tofu, then add the remaining 1 tbsp soy sauce and the wine around the edge of the pan. Stir for 30 seconds, then transfer the tofu to a plate.
Add the last 1 tbsp oil to the pan, then the green onions, ginger and garlic. Stir for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the celery and the 1/4 tsp salt and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Return the tofu to the pan. Stir the sauce again, since the cornstarch settles, and pour it in. Stir for 1 minute, until it turns glossy and coats the celery and tofu.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
method_notes: Yang's Kitchen (the lead) is the dish by name: smoked tofu stir-fried with soy and cooking wine, celery blanched first and added at the end for about a minute, ginger and green onion to start. It gives no amounts, so the quantities and the small cornstarch sauce come from Omnivore's Cookbook's dried tofu and celery stir-fry (the pork is left out, as its own vegan note suggests); Cup of Yum has the same recipe. No version has 20 ratings. Smoked tofu stands in for the dried tofu (xiang gan) those pages use.
